basics.name: Shruti Jain
basics.label: MS Computer Vision, Carnegie Mellon University

experience.name: Flowstate AI
highlights: Architected and shipped a video-editing system that connects natural-language intent with subject grounding, tracking, and temporally stable reframing.
Built a self-correcting pipeline combining VLM-based subject identification, SAM3 tracking, and trajectory verification to identify and correct tracking failures.
Improved soccer-ball tracking precision by 15.4% through automated jerk detection and correction of predicted trajectories.
Orchestrated scene- and shot-level processing in Temporal and developed component-level evaluations for tracking, framing stability, latency, and cost.

experience.name: AIRLab, Carnegie Mellon University
experience.summary: Advisors: Prof. Sebastian Scherer and Prof. John Galeotti
highlights: Developing a scene-graph-based approach to cross-view, cross-modal casualty re-identification, combining tracklet appearance, posture, and environmental context across aerial thermal and ground near-infrared video.
Developing a nighttime casualty-assessment framework that connects semi-automated identity association with VLM-based posture and hemorrhage analysis.
Built a training pipeline combining conditional RGB-to-thermal generation with VLM fine-tuning using LoRA and GRPO to address limited paired RGB–thermal data.

experience.name: Carnegie Mellon University
highlights: Contributed to DetPO, a gradient-free framework for adapting multimodal LLMs to few-shot object detection through text-prompt optimization and confidence calibration.
The framework improves detection without updating model weights, outperforming prior black-box approaches by up to 9.7 mAP on evaluations involving Roboflow20-VL and LVIS.
Co-authored the resulting ECCV 2026 paper.

experience.name: Palo Alto Networks
highlights: Developed Java Spring Boot microservices and APIs for ingesting AWS, Azure, and GCP account events into a production cloud-security pipeline.
Integrated scheduler-worker processing with SQS and Redis to support recurring data collection for near-real-time threat detection.
Contributed to fault-tolerant event-processing infrastructure serving enterprise customers across multiple cloud providers.

experience.name: Robotics Research Centre, IIIT Hyderabad
highlights: Implemented learned visual and latent prompts, adapters, and differentiable image preprocessing to adapt vision foundation models for vehicle foreground segmentation under adverse visual conditions.
Built parallel and serial adapter architectures to study how image-level and latent information support robust segmentation.
Contributed to DiffPrompter, published at IROS 2024, with evaluation of generalization from BDD100K to ACDC, WildDash, and Dark-Zurich.

experience.name: NEST Lab, Worcester Polytechnic Institute
highlights: Investigated learned feature representations for improving Ant Colony Optimization on the Travelling Salesman Problem.
Explored how deep learning could guide a classical optimization method, connecting representation learning with combinatorial search.

experience.name: AI and Robotics Lab (AIRL), IISc Bangalore
highlights: Worked on zero-shot object detection using textual descriptions and GAN-generated features for categories without visual training examples.
Combined zero-shot detection with continual-learning methods to study incremental recognition of new categories while retaining previously learned knowledge.

experience.name: Advect Systems – Printerverse
highlights: Developed a lightweight visual-monitoring pipeline to detect failed 3D prints in real time.
Combined OpenCV image processing with anomaly detection in Python to identify failures from visual observations during printing.

experience.name: Project MANAS
highlights: Contributed perception and computer vision modules to an autonomous-vehicle project, including work on sensor fusion and localization using LiDAR point clouds.
Worked on aerial-marker detection and classification for the AUVSI SUAS competition, connecting image processing and recognition with an autonomous UAV application.
Led AI research activities through technical workshops, paper-reading groups, and mentorship for undergraduate researchers.
Supported students in developing research projects and preparing their first publications, while coordinating work across technical disciplines.
